label: Travel time to the nearest key destination

inputs.name: open
inputs.description: Every edge's state: the comps_state ndtools reads.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: 1 if the travel time is within target_max hours of the intact network's, else 0 (ndtools' system state).

target_max.description: Extra time allowed over the intact network's travel time, in hours.

description: For each origin node (bind it to the non-key nodes), the travel time to the nearest node marked key_destination, over the open edges, by ndtools. Each edge's weight is length_km / avg_speed_kph, in hours. Joint across the Node plate: every origin reads the same link states in the same sample.
